scenes.title: Hook: funnel beside the tiller
scenes.picture: Frame 0, already moving: dolly_in through blown spray on Mateo, centred at the tiller, eyes wide. The warm cabin lamp in the companionway is the only warm light on his face. Over his shoulder, frame left, a mature moonlit waterspout towers from the sea to the cloud base, spray skirt churning. The moon sits upper left as the geography anchor, the tiller is in his fist, and the title card WATERSPOUT: 3 STEPS TO LIVE runs 0-2.5 s.

scenes.title: Whip to the funnel
scenes.picture: The tail of L01 carries over a whip_pan off Mateo that lands on the funnel base 90 m off the beam. A lightning-backlit thunder crack hits as a sheet of spray slams the lens and beads across frame.

scenes.title: Earlier: alone south of Bermuda
scenes.picture: aerial_flyover at 24 mm, descending on a single 9 m sloop centred on a calm magenta-gold swell. There are no other sails or lights to any horizon. The masthead light is already lit, the moon is rising upper left, and the mast stands tall and clear against the sky (plant). A rewind whoosh pushes the caption EARLIER on screen.

scenes.title: Threat planted: the dark spot
scenes.picture: Threat reveal, hero not looking: as L02 ends, Mateo is centred, head down, coiling a line in the cockpit with one knee braced on the tiller (plant), his back to the sea. Over his shoulder, frame left on the calm water, a dark circular patch darkens the swell. The patch is held a full beat while he never turns. The cabin lamp glows warm in the companionway.

scenes.title: Dead radio, spiral behind
scenes.picture: Dramatic irony: in a slow arc_track, Mateo clicks the VHF handset at the chart-table hatch, taps it twice, and the screen stays black. He shrugs and slaps the dead set. Behind him, frame left and soft-focus, the dark patch begins to curl into a faint spiral he does not see. The clock badge pops: DARK SPOT · 600 m.

scenes.title: The spot is spinning
scenes.picture: A low insert skims the water as the dark patch rotates, ribbed with spiral bands of lighter and darker sea. Cut to Mateo centred as he turns his head. His headlamp beam swings out and lands on the spiral, and his eyes snap wide.

scenes.title: Frozen
scenes.picture: As L04 finishes, a slow dolly_in at 65 mm holds on Mateo frozen and staring past camera, lit by moon key and cabin-lamp rim. A heartbeat thuds and the badge reads SPIRAL · 500 m.

scenes.title: Run straight away
scenes.picture: follow_tracking on Mateo as he shoves the tiller hard to bear away. The bow swings dead downwind away from the spiral, and the mainsail bellies out and snaps taut in a gust. A straight white wake opens behind the stern.

scenes.title: The gap stops growing
scenes.picture: A wide over-the-stern shot with Mateo's silhouette centred at the tiller and the young funnel frame left at the end of his straight wake. For a beat it holds the same size, then it slowly grows larger in frame as the wake line points right at it.

scenes.title: Spray ring forms
scenes.picture: The badge flips to SPRAY RING · 400 m as the camera pedestals up. Then a low_reveal from wave height shows a white ring of mist whirling around the funnel base, and the boat heels as a gust hits. A caption pops: STAGE 3 OF 5.

scenes.title: Stay with me
scenes.picture: Extreme close-up of Mateo's wet hand tightening on the tiller, then a rack to his eyes, which lock on the funnel off frame left. His headlamp beam swings with the heel and the cabin lamp sways warm behind him.

scenes.title: It grew up from the sea
scenes.picture: crane_rise starting on the churning sea surface at the funnel foot, climbing the spinning column of water and mist up to the cloud base. Lightning flashes through the cloud, and the badge reads MATURE · 300 m.

scenes.title: Tiny sloop, towering funnel
scenes.picture: The end of L09 cuts to a re-establishing extreme wide at 21 mm: the tiny sloop centred with its warm cabin-lamp glow, and the towering funnel frame left under the moon. The full funnel roar plays under the shot.

scenes.title: Step one: never steer closer
scenes.picture: Mateo, centred, starts to lean for a closer look, catches himself, and eases the tiller so the bow swings off the funnel instead of toward it. The STEP 1 badge slams in, then the bow slams a wave and spray sheets across the deck.

scenes.title: Step two: drift against the mast
scenes.picture: POV up the mast and shroud with the STEP 2 badge on screen. The funnel visibly slides sideways past the fixed mast line, frame left to centre. Cut to Mateo's unblinking eyes tracking it, headlamp beam steady.

scenes.title: Your heading is its path
scenes.picture: high_reveal from above the mast shows the funnel drifting onto the sloop's bow line. A dashed projected-course overlay runs from the bow straight into the funnel's track, and the badge reads MATURE · 180 m.

scenes.title: Breathe
scenes.picture: The shrouds thrum and vibrate. Close on Mateo's white-knuckle grip as his fingers twitch to yank the tiller, then he closes his eyes and lets out one long, slow exhale in the cabin-lamp glow. The funnel edge creeps into frame left.

scenes.title: Salt and seconds
scenes.picture: Spray lashes Mateo's face and he squints, blinking salt from red eyes. Cut wide: the gap between the stern and the spray skirt visibly shrinks, and the mainsail flogs wildly.

scenes.title: Running away failed
scenes.picture: Overhead top-down: the sloop's old straight wake line leads directly into the funnel base, and the badge hits MATURE · 90 m. The camera pushes down toward Mateo, small and centred at the tiller.

scenes.title: Reserved decision close-up
scenes.picture: As L15 lands on 'opposite instinct', the one reserved 85 mm close-up of the film begins: Mateo's face half moon-blue, half cabin-lamp orange. His jaw sets and his eyes go from the funnel to the tiller. Silence holds, then a tiller creak leads in.

scenes.title: Step three: turn ninety degrees
scenes.picture: Mateo throws the tiller hard over and the bow swings a full right angle across the funnel's track, the wake bending into an L. The STEP 3 badge lands. The boom bangs across overhead as the funnel slides past the stern, frame left, never touching the boat.

scenes.title: Funnel breaks into rain
scenes.picture: Astern, the funnel thins, kinks and collapses into a curtain of rain, and the badge flips to DECAY · CLEAR. Mateo, centred, sags against the coaming, chest heaving, a tired half-smile in the cabin-lamp glow as rain patters on his hood.

scenes.title: The calm breaks
scenes.picture: The sea goes glassy under the moon and Mateo relaxes, centred at the tiller. He glances back over his shoulder, frame left, where a new dark patch on the horizon begins to turn.

scenes.title: Loop frame
scenes.picture: The tail of L18 lands on a composition that matches frame 0: Mateo centred at the tiller, eyes wide, warm cabin lamp on his face, the spinning spot behind him frame left under the moon. Low thunder, then a hard cut to black.

elements.name: Open Atlantic south of Bermuda
must_do: hold moon upper-left as geography anchor
host the waterspout at readable distances 600-90 m

elements.name: Sloop cockpit and companionway
must_do: frame Mateo centred at the tiller
show companionway glow from the cabin lamp

elements.name: Procedural ocean surface
must_do: build chop and spray in vortex winds
show the spiral pattern on the surface

elements.name: Mateo, solo sailor (30s, oilskins, headlamp)
must_do: click and tap the dead radio

elements.name: 9 m sloop
must_do: turn ninety degrees across the funnel's track
read tiny beneath the funnel in wides

elements.name: Wooden tiller
must_do: be planted under Mateo's knee in S04
swing hard over for the ninety-degree turn

elements.name: Mast and shrouds (sight line)
must_do: stand clear against the sky in S03 (plant)
act as a fixed reference line in POV
show the funnel sliding past it

elements.name: Warm cabin lamp (the one practical carrying the night)
must_do: light Mateo's face against the cool moon key

elements.name: Masthead light
must_do: glow at the mast tip in the aerial view

elements.name: Boom
must_do: swing across the cockpit on the turn

elements.name: Dark spot / spiral on water (stage 1-2)
must_do: darken a circular patch of sea
be held behind the unaware hero
reappear on the horizon in the sting

elements.name: Waterspout funnel (stages 3-5)
must_do: grow up from the sea to the cloud

elements.name: Spray ring at funnel base
must_do: whirl a white mist ring around the base

elements.name: Lens spray droplets
must_do: slam the lens and bead across frame

elements.name: Boat wake line
must_do: bend into an L on the turn

elements.name: Lightning in cloud
must_do: flash through the cloud base on cue

elements.name: Moonlit night sky
must_do: provide the cool moon key from upper left
stay consistent as the geography anchor

elements.name: Golden-magenta dusk sky
must_do: light the setup in warm magenta-gold
show the moon rising upper left

elements.name: Hook title: WATERSPOUT: 3 STEPS TO LIVE
must_do: display 0-2.5 s over the moving hook

elements.name: Spout stage and distance badge
must_do: read DARK SPOT 600 m, SPIRAL 500 m, SPRAY RING 400 m, MATURE 300 m, MATURE 180 m, MATURE 90 m, DECAY CLEAR

elements.name: STEP 1/2/3 badges
must_do: slam in on each step line

elements.name: Projected course / track line
must_do: draw the bow heading into the funnel's track
redraw at a right angle on the turn

elements.name: Kinetic captions (Inter 900, up to 3 words)
must_do: pop one to three words on the VO

elements.name: Facial and body acting rig
must_do: drive fear, freeze, breath and decision expressions
keep faces low-key but never black
